sentences.en: The sun and a damp climate made the tropical rainforest.
sentences.zh: 阳光和潮湿的气候造就了热带雨林。

sentences.en: She used a damp rag to wipe off the dust.
sentences.zh: 她用一块湿抹布擦掉了灰尘。

sentences.en: The weather was not only cold, it was also damp.
sentences.zh: 天气不仅寒冷，还很潮湿。

senses.zh: 使潮湿；使沮丧，抑制；使阻尼 -
